visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Binary Search Instead of a Linear Scan
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A loop scans from the start until it finds the first 2. Use a binary search that moves left after each hit. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: On a sorted array a binary search needs about log2(n) comparisons instead of up to n, which for a million items is 20 steps instead of a million.
